record.question: Who received the National Handloom Award - ‘The Tribal Weaves Award’ in August 2024?
record.explanation: Answer A: Vanlalruati. The Development Commissioner (Handlooms) 2023 award catalogue names Mizoram’s Vanlalruati as a National Handloom Award recipient in the Tribal Weave category; the August 2024 ceremony presented the award. Reference: https://handlooms.nic.in/assets/img/EBOOK/Handloom%20Award%20Catalogue%202023.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
